issues.title: Bind the support drafter's ticket scope to a leased job
issues.note: The issue proposes binding the support drafter's ticket access to an active, unexpired job via row-level security on `support.tickets` and `support.ticket_messages` to prevent a compromised runtime from reading all tickets. This belongs to the security and database access control area. The issue references a specific test (`test_the_support_login_still_chooses_the_drafters_ticket_known_boundary`) that must be updated, but lacks implementation details or migration strategy. No duplicate found.

issues.title: Pin pip installs in the workflows with hashes
issues.note: The issue reports that CI workflows install Python tools (`checkov`, `zizmor`, and the project itself via `pip install -e .`) without pinned hashes, causing a low OpenSSF Scorecard rating for Pinned Dependencies. Area: CI/CD supply chain security. Missing information: specific workflow file paths and whether a `requirements.txt` with hashes already exists. No duplicate found.

issues.title: Collect a second person's labels for the judge
issues.note: The issue requests adding support for a second human labeller to record verdicts alongside the existing calibration data and report inter-annotator agreement. Area: evaluation/calibration tooling. Missing information: specific file format or CLI changes desired for the new labels. No duplicate found.

issues.title: Version the steps of runs in flight
issues.note: The issue reports that resuming a run after a deploy can replay incorrect outputs if an agent's steps were added, removed, or reordered. It belongs to the run resumption and versioning area. No information appears missing; the problem and a solution pattern (versioning per agent implementation) are clearly described. No duplicate found.
